The '''''Consolidator''''' was an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] during the [[Legacy era]].

==History==
In [[44 ABY]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] ordered the ''Consolidator'' to bombard the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hagamoor 3]] in order to destroy the [[Moon Maiden]] mine, which was a secretly a laboratory owned by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]].
